response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience as a Senior Software Developer with over 12 years of diverse full-stack development, including leadership roles and contributions to AI-agent infrastructure. His proficiency in TypeScript, Node.js, React, and cloud platforms aligns well with the primary stack, while his experience with Kotlin/Java and testing frameworks (Vitest, Jest) matches secondary and required skills. His work on scalable systems, performance optimizations, and collaboration with product teams demonstrates strong engineering and problem-solving abilities.
strengths: Deep experience with full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, React, Nest.js) and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
Strong background in AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling, including MCP and testing frameworks (Vitest, Jest)
Proven track record of leading projects, optimizing performance, and improving development processes (e.g., AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq, pricing team at Optilyz)
concerns: Limited explicit mention of PostgreSQL, MySQL, or NoSQL databases in recent roles (though MongoDB is listed under skills)
No direct experience with Vitest mentioned in employment history, despite being a primary stack requirement
Shorter tenure in some roles (e.g., 5 months at re:cinq) may raise questions about long-term commitment
